script: Three unreal things young couples do at Japanese summer festivals. First, the outfits are completely stunning. Instead of normal clothes, everyone wears a beautiful traditional summer robe called a Yukata. Seeing your date dressed up like a real-life anime character for the first time is considered a massive romantic milestone. Next, the street food is an absolute dream. You do not sit down at a boring restaurant. Instead, you walk around together sharing massive fluffy shaved ice, chocolate-covered bananas, and sweet candy apples right from the glowing festival stalls. But the absolute best part? The secret fireworks spot. At the end of the night, huge fireworks light up the sky. But instead of standing in the loud crowds, couples will intentionally sneak away to a quiet hill or riverbank just to hold hands and watch the show completely alone.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: Three unreal things young couples do at Japanese summer festivals.
